cues: Enthalpy of solution is itself a tug of war.
Pulling the ionic lattice apart costs energy, the lattice enthalpy.
Water molecules wrapping the separated ions release energy, the hydration enthalpy.
For ammonium chloride, the lattice term wins by a little.
Net, plus fifteen point one kilojoules per mole.
